primary_title: Microvesicles released from microglia stimulate synaptic activity via enhanced sphingolipid metabolism
decision_basis: The cited primary directly measured increased ceramide production in neurons exposed to microglia-derived microvesicles, with lipid-pathway perturbations supporting the output.
limitations_preserved: Promote the measured neuronal ceramide output as a refinement of the broader sphingolipid relay. Preserve mouse-to-rat comparator context and do not infer a receptor or transcript/protein intermediate.
